text: Invite notifications swallowed while the app is open; a joined invite lingers until the next sync; 'Duplicate' reads 'Duplicate list'

On main (2c03e7c7), full gate green: an invite is marked seen only when posted or rendered in the inbox (a foreground/switch/permission stop leaves it unseen for the next background check); a joined invite leaves the inbox at once on both clients; 'Duplicate list' in nine locales on both.
